## Build time vs run time

`import.meta.env.VITE_*` → **compiled into the browser bundle at build time.** Public, readable in devtools. Changing it needs a **rebuild**, not a restart.

`process.env.*` inside a `createServerFn` / `"use server"` file → **read at run time on the server.** Never shipped. Changing it needs a **restart**, not a rebuild.

**Judge the value, not the variable name.** A name ending in `_KEY` proves nothing either way.
`sb_publishable_*`, `pk_*` and Supabase anon keys are public by design and belong in client code.
`sb_secret_*`, `sk_*`, service-role keys and passwords must never reach a module client code imports.

## Which side of the wire

`.tsx` → **client** (149 files). **45** file(s) use `createServerFn`/`"use server"` → **server**.
A plain `.ts` module is **neither until something imports it** — it becomes client code the moment a component does.
Check with `grep -rl "<module>" src --include=*.tsx` before putting anything sensitive in one.

## Code style — enforced, not preference

- TypeScript `strict` is on — no implicit `any`, null checks enforced.
- `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` is on — indexing an array yields `T | undefined`.
- Path aliases: `@/*` — use them, not deep relative paths.
- Prettier is authoritative: printWidth: 100, semi: true, singleQuote: false, trailingComma: "all". Do not hand-format.
- ESLint config `eslint.config.js`. Lint must pass — never add an `eslint-disable` to silence a rule without saying why.

## Testing

- Run one file: `npx vitest run path/to/file.test.ts` · one test by name: `npx vitest run -t "name"` · watch: `npx vitest`.
- 117 test file(s) alongside source.

## Data and migrations

- Supabase migrations in `supabase/migrations/` (76 file(s)). Applied migrations are immutable — add a new one.
- Supabase access is gated by **RLS**, not key secrecy. A publishable key in client code is expected — the policy is the boundary. A service-role key never belongs in client-reachable code.

## What CI gates a merge on

- `ci.yml`: `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `npm run build`

If it fails in CI it is not done, whatever passed locally.

## Deployment

- `<pm> run preview` serves the built output — use it to reproduce a production-only bug (`node .output/server/index.mjs`).

## Security

- `.env` exists and is **not** in `.gitignore`. Check `git ls-files .env` before putting anything sensitive in it.

## Commits and PRs

- Commit subjects are free-form (35% conventional). Match the surrounding style; do not impose a new convention.
- Never force-push, rebase, or amend commits that are already pushed.

## Reporting back

State what changed and which commands you actually ran. If you skipped a check, say so — never imply a verification you did not perform.
